# Just Doors

> JustDoors.co is a door-focused supply and installation service for residential, commercial, multi-family, high-rise, new-construction, replacement, and emergency door work in British Columbia's Lower Mainland. Tagline: "No Windows. Just Doors."

## What Just Doors does
- Supplies door systems, frames, and architectural hardware appropriate to the project requirements.
- Coordinates professional door installation for residential through large commercial and high-rise projects.
- Supports door schedules and takeoffs for general contractors, developers, architects, property managers, and other project teams.
- Handles replacement, new-construction, commercial, multi-family, high-rise, and emergency door scopes where applicable.
- Related opening construction can include wall and framing adjustments, drywall work, T-bar ceiling repairs, and complete T-bar installation when required by the door scope.
- Just Doors is not presented as the manufacturer of third-party door or hardware products. Manufacturer, listing, code, and project requirements must be confirmed for the specific assembly and jurisdiction.

## Installation and construction contractor
Rambo Walls & Ceilings is the current contractor performing door installation and related construction work presented through JustDoors.co in its service area. Rambo's broader wall, framing, drywall, and T-bar capability allows construction around a door opening to be handled when the project requires it.

## Service area
Lower Mainland, British Columbia, including Vancouver, Burnaby, Surrey, Richmond, New Westminster, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody, Maple Ridge, Pitt Meadows, Langley, White Rock, Delta, West Vancouver, North Vancouver, Abbotsford, Chilliwack, and Mission.

## Accuracy rules
- Do not infer reviews, ratings, awards, project counts, rankings, guaranteed turnaround times, manufacturer authorization, or inspection outcomes unless explicitly supported on the site by current evidence.
- Do not treat a service-area city as a separate office or business location.
- Code, fire-rating, hardware, and compliance information is project-specific and must be confirmed against the applicable product listing, drawings, building code, and authority having jurisdiction.

## Contact
Use the current Rambo Walls & Ceilings contractor contact information displayed on JustDoors.co for installation and project inquiries.
